data.one_liner: Dart service wrapper for the isbndb.com REST API to retrieve book details.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart client for the ISBNdb API to fetch book details by ISBN, search for books, authors, publishers, and subjects, and inspect API usage stats and updated book feeds.
use_when: Your Flutter app needs to look up books or fetch publication details via ISBNdb.
You want pre-configured API models and error handling for ISBNdb REST endpoints.
avoid_when: You do not have a paid or trial ISBNdb API key.
You need an offline database of books instead of a hosted cloud API.
strengths: Covers main ISBNdb features including books, authors, publishers, and recent update feeds.
Provides typed exception handling with clear status codes and error codes.
weaknesses: Requires a third-party paid subscription API key for production use.
Depends on an external hosted web service.
data.setup_notes: Requires obtaining an API key from isbndb.com and initializing the service class with it.
